fold_assignment: within state SHA256(seed:physical-location) order, round robin; all years together
fitting_weight: each location totals one; divide by admitted observation count in the training fold
metric_unit: one arithmetic-mean actual and prediction pair per physical location; supplementary row errors use inverse location observation count

preprocessing.scope: training fold only, including inner folds
preprocessing.missing: weighted-median training-fold imputation plus train-varying missing indicators; all-missing columns excluded with reasons
preprocessing.baseline_missing: exclude any feature with missing training values; prediction noncomputable if a retained baseline feature is missing
preprocessing.scaling: weighted training mean and population standard deviation
preprocessing.latent: weighted training SVD PCA; at most 2, 4 or 6 components and at most floor(location_count/5)
preprocessing.splines: additive linear natural-tail truncated-power spline, weighted training knots at 1/3 and 2/3; at most three terms per input
preprocessing.protected_characteristics: catalog exclusion mandatory; direct protected-class inputs denied

family_experiments.removals: all features minus each family, including baseline families

tuning.baseline: higher inner grouped Spearman, lower log RMSE, grid order (accepted MODEL-13 procedure)
tuning.others: minimum inner grouped log RMSE; ties prefer fewer active dimensions then grid order
tuning.convergence_failure: candidate unavailable; never silently accept unconverged solver

stability.scope: outer-fold fitted models only; no held-out targets
stability.linear: align signed standardized coefficients to original features, retain separate missingness/state effects, and L1-normalize each fold vector; PCA coefficients backproject through its fitted loadings
stability.nonlinear: align nonnegative spline basis norms, tree impurity importances, or ensemble-mixture importances to original features and L1-normalize each fold vector
stability.score: mean over all outer-fold pairs of 1 minus half the L1 distance between normalized vectors; a pair containing an all-zero vector scores zero
stability.activity: missing or zero coordinates receive no shared effect mass; unweighted pairwise active-support Jaccard is also reported
stability.minimum_score_interpretation: 0.6 requires mean shared normalized effect/importance mass of at least 60 percent; dense activation or positive-only importance cannot satisfy this by itself
stability.limitation: normalization assesses relative effect/importance distribution; nonlinear importance agreement does not prove full response-shape stability and is not causal importance

selection.all_location_omission: remove each physical location from fixed OOF score aggregation, without refitting; record max pooled log-RMSE ratio and min pooled Spearman difference against identically omitted baseline; undefined ratio or rank fails closed
selection.family_robustness_gate: remove incremental non-baseline features within each family; preserve accepted baseline definitions; full-family removals remain reported separately

limitations: Development selection among a bounded library is not independent confirmation
State partial pooling shrinks state intercepts only; the sample does not support unrestricted market-specific slopes
Tree importance is descriptive impurity importance, not a causal effect
Location-mean rank metrics do not measure within-location temporal change; supplementary row errors retain that information
Protected targets, memberships, fitted coefficients, feature importances and exact fitted-model artifacts stay protected local
